attr.title: Balatro
attr.desc: Balatro is a poker-inspired roguelike deck builder all about creating powerful synergies and winning big.
attr.inst: Purchase the game from Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2379780/Balatro/. On macOS, copy Balatro.love from Balatro.app/Contents/Resources into the balatro folder. On Windows, copy Balatro.exe into the balatro folder.
